[[File:Apocalypse_Barge.png|thumb|right|250px|The ''Apocalypse Barge'']]
The '''''Apocalypse Barge''''' was a floating party barge used by the wealthy of [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] during the [[Battle of Corellia]], who wished to witness the so-called "apocalypse" from a place of privilege.
